title: File:Village Gardens Feed Schoolchildren- Food Production at Knighton-on-teme, Worcestershire, England, UK, 1943 D17515.jpg
author: Ministry of Information Photo Division Photographer, Smith Jack
description:
Village Gardens Feed Schoolchildren- Food Production at Knighton-on-teme, Worcestershire, England, UK, 1943
Thomas Guy (left) and John Bourne collect vegetable peelings and other scraps left over from the lunchtime meal at the village school in Knighton-on-Teme.  All the vegetables eaten at the school were supplied by the local Village Produce Association.  By collecting the scraps for pig swill, none of the vegetables are wasted.

title: File:James Warner cigarette packs, circa 1969 (6152483663).jpg
author: USMC Archives from Quantico, USA
description:
James Warner, a Marine aviator, was shot down over Vietnam and inprisoned in October 1967.  During his captivity Warner collected the discarded cigarette packages of the camp guards and used them to create his own geometry textbook.  He wrote with a bamboo nib; the ink was made with cigarette ashes.  The "math book" was 62 pages long.  Warner was eventually liberated in March 1973.

From the James H. Warner Collection (COLL/4522) at the Marine Corps Archives & Special Collections.
